aiPrompt.line1: Create a premium 16:9 front-page marketing image for a professional course.
aiPrompt.line2: The image should feel like something used to sell the course: polished, optimistic, trustworthy and high quality.
aiPrompt.line3: Show happy, confident, successful people in a positive learning situation connected to the course topic.
aiPrompt.line4: The mood should communicate progress, mastery, collaboration and practical value.
aiPrompt.line5: Use a clean modern composition with warm natural light and enough visual space for a course title to be placed outside the image later.
aiPrompt.line6: Do not include any text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, UI screens with readable text, or brand names inside the image.
